tools.name: catalog
tools.description: Lists the parts a Protoship device is built from: the always-included Arduino Nano ESP32 on its carrier, the modules (function, plug, I2C address, limits) and the enclosure options, plus the power and delivery rules. Free, no side effects.

tools.description: Prices a device built from catalog modules: parts, enclosure, assembly, shipping, Protoship fee and VAT for the destination country, as one total, plus a delivery estimate, a quote_id for reserve, a reserve_url your user can open, and an ESPHome starter config.
